citation.authors: Perera MA, Cavallari LH, Limdi NA, Gamazon ER et al

cited_by.title: How some medicines work differently by gene

record.population: 533 African American adults on stable warfarin (discovery) and 432 (replication)
record.finding: VKORC1 and CYP2C9 explain less dose variation in people of African descent than in Europeans or Asians. A novel variant in the CYP2C cluster (rs12777823) reached genome-wide significance in the discovery cohort and was confirmed in the replication cohort.
record.note: African American adults; a genetic association, not a trial. The abstract was cut before the effect size on dose.
